mostWorthwhile.text: Making collagen chains and exporting them into supporting fibers connected the repair cell’s internal work to the tissue it helps rebuild. The described sequence was clear from the supplied picture descriptions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the finished fibers to the body was a predictable step, though the resulting cross-section clearly showed what remained to be repaired.

surprise.text: The closed surface did not mean repair was finished: the deeper collagen was still loosely arranged and remodeling would continue.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the items and goals gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter if it offered a similarly clear connection between cellular work and a visible body function, though the combinations here were mostly predictable.
